title: SIPP monthly child presence and reference-parent care universes are different
source_unit: SIPP positive-weight person record by reference month

denominator.unit: positive-weight person-record/month rows with no household members under 18 in that month

reference_parent_ERP_yes.unit: person-record/month rows with ERP=1; 0.25% of rows

paid_childcare_nonblank_rows.unit: rows with nonblank EPAY; child-care fields use separate fall/December/reference-parent universes

childcare_work_prevention_nonblank_rows.unit: rows with nonblank EWORKMORE; separate reference-parent/child-age universe

time_lost_nonblank_rows.unit: rows with nonblank ETIMELOST; conditional on EWORKMORE

observations.method: Streaming audit of the official 2025 SIPP public-use slice using WPFINWGT-positive person-month rows; cross-tabulated monthly RHNUMU18 against ERP and nonblank care fields. No household prevalence or variance estimate is claimed.
observations.uncertainty: This is a universe/structure audit, not a population estimate. Counts are subject to the selected slice, survey missingness, and the distinction between monthly and annual/reference-year variables.
observations.subgroup: Monthly household under-18 presence versus adult reference-parent indicator.
observations.counterinterpretation: The overlap is consistent with ERP identifying an annual/reference-year parent while RHNUMU18 is a monthly household composition field; it is not evidence that adults without children in the household received ordinary child care.

related_sources.claim: ERP is an adult reference-parent indicator; RHNUMU18 is a monthly household under-18 count; child-care fields have separate fall/December universes.

boundary: This record documents a source-universe mismatch and does not estimate child-care prevalence, household prevalence, causal care effects, or cultural/political meaning.
